info.title: SGF ERP API
info.description:
REST API of the Safe Guard Force ERP (Phase 1 - setup, auth, files, notifications, dashboard).
Other module teams add their own path fragments; this file covers the shared core only.

Envelope - every JSON response is `{ "data": <any>, "meta": { ... }, "errors": [ { "field": "mobile", "message": "..." } ] }`.
`errors` is empty on success; `field` is omitted for non-field errors. On error `data` is null.

Money is integer paise (columns ending in `_paise`). Datetimes are UTC `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`; show them in IST (Asia/Kolkata).
IDs are integers. Booleans are stored and returned as 0/1 integers (`is_active`, `is_system`...); JSON true/false is accepted on write.

List contract (every list endpoint) - `?search=&filter[col]=val&from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD&sort=col&dir=asc|desc&page=1&per_page=25`.
`search` is a LIKE over the resource's search columns; `filter[col]` is an exact match on whitelisted columns (comma list = IN, `__null` = IS NULL);
`from`/`to` are IST calendar dates applied to the resource's date column (default `created_at`); `per_page` is at most 200 (default 25);
`export=xlsx` runs the same query without paging and returns an .xlsx file (`Content-Disposition` carries the filename).
List `meta` is `{page, per_page, total, last_page, sort, dir}`. Unknown filter/sort names are ignored.

Status codes - 200/201 ok; 401 not signed in, session expired or revoked; 403 signed in but lacking the permission (or account/device refused);
404 not found (also returned for records outside the caller's branch scope); 409 conflict (e.g. delete refused while dependants exist);
422 validation failed (one entry per field in `errors`); 429 rate-limited (login lock-out, OTP limits).

Auth - the web panel uses HttpOnly cookies `sgf_access` (15 min) and `sgf_refresh` (7 days) set by login.
The mobile app and API clients send `X-Auth-Mode: token` on login / OTP verify / refresh to receive
`data.tokens = {access_token, refresh_token, expires_in}` and then send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.
On 401 call `POST /auth/refresh` once (cookie, or body `{refresh_token}` in token mode) and retry.
Integrations may instead send `X-Api-Key`. Every authenticated route checks `<module>.<action>` against the caller's role (or key) permissions.

bearerAuth.description:
App and API clients. Send header `X-Auth-Mode: token` on `/auth/login`, `/auth/otp/verify` and `/auth/refresh`
to receive `data.tokens = {access_token, refresh_token, expires_in}` in the body, then send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

apiKeyAuth.name: X-Api-Key
apiKeyAuth.description:
Third-party integrations. Format `sgf_<prefix>_<secret>` where prefix is 8 lowercase letters/digits and the secret is 32-64 letters/digits.
The key carries its own permission set and can never hold full access (`*`). No user is attached, so audit rows record user_id NULL.
Expired or inactive keys get 401.

kpis.description:
Keyed by KPI. Every KPI has `label`, `value` (headline number) and `link` (web path), plus:
- `deployed_vs_required`: required (site requirements active today), deployed (open deployments today), gap, percent, short_sites
- `absentees`: marked_absent (attendance status absent today) + not_checked_in (rostered duties whose shift started with no attendance row)
- `open_incidents`: by_severity {critical, high, medium, low} (status open/in_progress)
- `active_sos`: unacknowledged (status active), acknowledged, oldest_raised_at
- `missed_patrols`: due (rounds due so far today), completed, partial, compliance (%)
- `billing_vs_collected`: billed_paise (invoices issued with invoice_date in the IST month), collected_paise (payments received this month), outstanding_paise, percent, month
- `contracts_expiring`: items (first 5 active contracts ending within 30 days)

attendance.description: Last 14 IST days. percent = (present + late + half_day/2) / (rows - weekly_off - leave).

billing.description: Last 6 months (YYYY-MM), billed vs collected in paise.

secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 signing secret. Only in GET /webhooks/{id}, create and rotate-secret responses.

failure_count.description: Consecutive failed deliveries; at auto_disable_after the webhook is switched off and super admins are notified.

events.description: Event names from GET /webhooks/events, or ["*"] for all
